shift.started: Shift started. Take a truck at the counter.
shift.wrong_job: Only tow company employees can clock in here.

garage.title: Company trucks
garage.flatbed_hint: Winch, carries one vehicle on the bed
garage.hook_hint: Tow arm, tows one vehicle behind
garage.already_out: You already have a truck out.
garage.spot_busy: The truck spot is blocked. Clear it first.
garage.too_far: Bring the truck back to the yard first.

tow.yard_hint: Unload the vehicle here: hold [ALT], aim at the truck: Unload the vehicle
tow.no_control: The vehicle did not respond. Try again.
tow.hook_missed: The hook did not catch. Back up closer to the vehicle and try again.
tow.needs_order: Emergency and military vehicles are only towed on an order.
tow.too_close: Too close: move the truck forward %s m.
tow.no_ramps: The ramps could not be placed here.
tow.too_far: Too far: back the truck up %s m.
tow.off_side: The vehicle is %s m off to the side: line the truck up behind it.
tow.off_angle: The vehicle stands at %s° to the truck: line the truck up straighter in front of it.
tow.uneven: The ground under the ramps is uneven (kerb or pothole): stop on level ground.
tow.guide_ok: Ready to load: hook the winch cable.
tow.not_straight: The winch could not straighten the vehicle on the ground: line the truck up behind it and try again.
tow.cannot_climb: The vehicle could not make it up the ramps and was let back down.
tow.cannot_unload: The vehicle did not come down and is strapped on the bed again. Try again.
tow.path_blocked: Something is in the way to the ramps. Clear the path and try again.
tow.landing_blocked: There is no room behind the ramps. Clear the space and try again.

calls.title: Tow calls
calls.command_help: Call a tow truck for the vehicle you are in or drove last
calls.created: Tow truck called. You will get a message when a driver accepts.
calls.none_open: You have no open tow call.
calls.cooldown: Wait a minute before calling again.
calls.already_open: You already have an open tow call.
calls.busy: All tow drivers are busy. Try again later.
calls.no_vehicle: Stand next to your vehicle to call a tow truck.
calls.not_owner: Only the owner can call a tow truck for this vehicle.
calls.reopened: Your driver dropped the call. It is open again.
calls.completed: Your vehicle is at the impound yard.
calls.vehicle_gone: Your tow call closed: the vehicle is gone.
calls.drop_loaded: The vehicle is on your truck. Hand it over at the impound yard or unload it first.
calls.route_yard: Vehicle loaded. Route set to the impound yard.
calls.unavailable: Tow calls are not available on this server.
calls.cancel_loaded: Your vehicle is already on the truck. The call cannot be cancelled now.

impound.nothing_here: None of your vehicles are here.
impound.release_confirm: Pay %s and take the vehicle. Cash is used first, then bank.
impound.released: Your vehicle is waiting at the exit.
impound.no_spot: The exit is blocked. Try again in a moment.
impound.police_hold: This vehicle is on a police hold.
impound.cleared: Vehicle cleared. No order, no pay.
impound.not_in_yard: Drive into the impound yard first.
impound.no_cargo: Nothing is loaded on the truck.
impound.too_fast: Delivery refused: the trip was too fast.
impound.no_order: This vehicle has an owner and no tow order.

contracts.message: Broken down at the roadside. Doors locked, hazards on.

abandoned.message: Left without a driver for %s+ minutes.

police.hold_hours_hint: 0 keeps the hold until an officer lifts it
police.ordered: Tow ordered. Drivers on shift have the call.
police.already_ordered: This vehicle already has a tow order.
police.limit: Order limit reached for this hour.
